[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Bob Hudsol''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was a resistance leader in [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]], and he developed connections to the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Hudsol was stationed in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Alliance base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. In that battle, Hudsol kept small groups of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] separated from one another to allow multiple attacks on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. The battle was won when [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] destroyed the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], and Hudsol was present at the ceremony held in honor of Skywalker and other [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|heroes]] of the battle.

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="anh" /> Bob Hudsol [[Corellian/Legends|hailed]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CSWE" /> A member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Hudsol was a resistance leader in [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]] and developed strong ties to the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]]. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Hudsol had become a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the Alliance's [[Alliance Military/Legends|military forces]].<ref name="dec">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Rebel Commander}}</ref> That year, Hudsol was in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], the Alliance's base on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], the base's commander, received the [[Death Star plans/Legends|stolen plans]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. Dodonna analyzed the plans and found that the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] had a weakness in its [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] found in one of its surface trenches, which would be vulnerable to [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]]. A successful attack would lead to a chain reaction that would destroy the whole [[Space station/Legends|station]]. Hudsol attended a meeting during which Dodonna discussed his findings, and arranged for the base's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] to [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|attack]] the Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="anh" />

[[File:Medals.png|thumb|right|400px|Hudsol was present at the ceremony of awarding the Medal of Bravery to the Heroes of Yavin.]]
During the battle, Hudsol was in the base's [[command center]] with Dodonna, keeping watch over the battle.<ref name="anh" /> He kept small groups of starfighters separated from one another to allow several different attacks on the Death Star.<ref name="CSWE" /> The battle was won when the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] successfully fired proton torpedoes into the Death Star's exhaust port, effectively destroying the station. Following the battle, Hudsol was present alongside Dodonna in the ceremony awarding the [[Medal of Bravery/Legends|Medal of Bravery]] to the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]]: Skywalker and [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="anh" />

==Personality and traits==
Bob Hudsol was typical of hard-line Corellian military [[Officer/Legends|officers]] who were known for being cautious in battle.<ref name="dec" /> Hudsol had [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="anh" />

==Equipment==
Hudsol wore the same [[Alliance military uniform/Legends|uniform]] as the other officers present in the Great Temple.<ref name="anh" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The script [of ''The Star Wars Holiday Special''] revealed that the cartoon's Rebel leader was named General Ristt, apparently a stylized version of a minor character from ''Star Wars''{{'}} Yavin 4 base scenes, judging by the facial hair.|Alex Newborn|<ref name="insider">{{InsiderCite|106|I Have a Bad Feeling About This!}}</ref>}}
Bob Hudsol first appeared in [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] as one of the minor Rebel characters seen first in the briefing before the Battle of Yavin, and then during the battle itself and in the ceremony honoring the Heroes of Yavin.<ref name="anh" /> In [[1978]], a similar-looking Rebel officer appeared in ''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]'', a cartoon that was shown in ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''. Referred to only as a "General" by other characters in the cartoon itself,<ref name="Wookiee">''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]''</ref> the character was identified as General [[Ristt]] in the ''Holiday Special''{{'s}} script.<ref name="script">{{WebCite|url=http://starwarsholidayspecial.com/text/script.htm|text=The Fourth Draft Script - 09/13/78|work=[[Starwarsholidayspecial.com|The Star Wars Holiday Special]]|archivedate=20101223071504}}</ref> Hudsol was first identified by name in a card for the ''[[A New Hope Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="dec" /> Despite that, as a result of Hudsol's resemblance to Ristt, Dr. [[Curtis Saxton]] mistook the two for the same character in his [[Curtis Saxton|Star Wars Technical Commentaries]].<ref name="saxton">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/swtc/domino.html|text=Rebel Alliance Insignia|author=[[Curtis Saxton]]|date=1997-11-16|work=[[Curtis Saxton|Star Wars Technical Commentaries]]|archivedate=20110720231506}}</ref> The two characters have also been mistaken as being the same on the fan site [[Starwarsholidayspecial.com]].<ref name="Fan site">{{WebCite|url=http://starwarsholidayspecial.com/characters/ristt.htm|text=General Ristt|work=[[Starwarsholidayspecial.com|The Star Wars Holiday Special]]|archivedate=20101223062637}}</ref> In addition, [[Alex Newborn]], the author of the article ''[[I Have a Bad Feeling About This!]]'' published in [[Star Wars Insider 106|''Star Wars Insider'' 106]], speculated that Ristt was a stylized version of Hudsol.<ref name="insider" />
